body: Takhti was born in Tehran in 1930.
He became Iran's Olympic freestyle wrestling star.
He won a gold medal at the 1956 Melbourne Olympics.
He earned silver medals in Rome and Tokyo.
Crowds admired his humility and fair play.
Takhti often helped opponents after fierce matches.
His title Jahan Pahlavan means world champion.
The title reflected respect, not just victories.
He became a symbol of Iranian sportsmanship.
His wrestling legacy still inspires athletes today.
His 1960 Olympic moment showed his global skill.
A Tehran statue honors his lasting memory.
People remember Takhti for character and courage.
optional_closing: His name remains tied to honor.
